profile.headline: Software Engineer | MLOps
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer who loves to work on challenging projects. As a technical lead at Thermo Fisher Scientific, I help my team explore and build new ways to automate our electron microscopes.
Skills: .Net, python, SQL, OpenCV, pandas, scikit-learn, pipeline, PyTorch, AWS sagemaker, seaborn, jupyter notebook

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Clara County, California, United States · On-site
positions.insights: Software Infrastructure, Software Design and +1 skill

positions.title: SDE
positions.description:
✨ ML Infrastructure Expertise
- Developed infrastructure that efficiently trained and deployed thousands of multi-modal ML models. 
- Optimized GPU usage, achieving a 6x reduction in model inference costs, making products viable and scalable.
- Implemented storage optimization techniques, reducing the storage requirements for Amazon's catalog classifications by 85%.
- Proficient in AWS SageMaker, ECS.

📊 Data Warehousing Achievements
- Created a robust data warehouse to support LLM/traditional ML fine-tuning and training
- Handled data pipelines at the scale of Amazon's vast catalog, ensuring efficient storage, retrieval, and processing
- Implemented cost-effective solutions to manage massive production datasets used for ML experiments. Resulting in a 90% reduction in storage costs.
- Proficient in Apache Spark, Redshift, AWS Glue, Step Function, Athena.

🎯 Event-Driven Architecture Proficiency
- Designed and implemented event-driven architectures for real-time processing
- Leveraged AWS event driven services like SNS, SQS, Kinesis, Lambda, and Kinesis Firehose to build scalable, fault-tolerant systems
- Optimized event-driven workflows to minimize latency and improve system performance
- Designed microservices using AWS resources like API Gateway, DynamoDB, Lambda, and EC2, ensuring loose coupling and independent scalability.
positions.insights: Software Design, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +14 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
•	Coordinates effort of 4 internal teams with different fields of study including software, physics, chemical, and hardware engineers. 
•	Creates architecture solutions, and algorithm for an automatic navigation system for a fleet of electron microscopes. Tools: .NET, python, Windows service, REST, TCP/IP, load balancer 
•	Develops pipeline to collect, process data; visualize; and predict microscopes performance. Tools: MySQL, Flask, pandas, matplotlib, scikit-learn 
•	Develops an image pattern recognition using CAD design system. Tool: OpenCV

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed Windows applications for electron microscopes. Tools: .Net, WPF, Windows workflow, MySQL 
•	Worked closely with electron microscopy scientists and helped develop a semiconductor defect processing workflow. 
•	Developed image processing tools for application engineers. Tools: C#

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
•	Developed a video annotation tool for other students. Tools: C++, fltk 
•	Replicated results from papers and produced a traffic violation detection library. 
•	Developed service to keep records of road traffic, detect and alert traffic abnormality.

positions.title: IT Technician
positions.description:
•	Managed macOS and Windows systems for the university.
•	Wrote automated scripts for the school's Linux printing server. Tools: shell, perl
•	Provided technical support for teachers and lab attendants.
